export function up(db) {
  db.exec(`CREATE TABLE sprints (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    goal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK(status IN ('planned','active','completed')),
    started_at TEXT,
    completed_at TEXT,
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT
  );
  CREATE INDEX sprints_project ON sprints(project_id,start_date,id);
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sprints_one_active ON sprints(project_id) WHERE status='active';
  CREATE TABLE sprint_issues (
    sprint_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sprints(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
    estimate REAL NOT NULL,
    remaining REAL NOT NULL,
    done INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(done IN (0,1)),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    added_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    removed_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY(sprint_id,issue_id)
  );
  CREATE INDEX sprint_issues_issue ON sprint_issues(issue_id,active);
  CREATE TABLE sprint_changes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sprint_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sprints(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    issue_id TEXT,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_delta REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    remaining_delta REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    issue_delta INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    remaining_issue_delta INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  );
  CREATE INDEX sprint_changes_day ON sprint_changes(sprint_id,at,id);`);
}
